description: This source file defines an ASP.NET web page class 'AdminCourseQueue' in the OnlineExamSystem project. It contains event handlers for page load, button clicks for navigation (home, leaderboard, logout), and a grid view selection change that sets a session variable and transfers control to another page.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: ASP.NET web page class for managing the admin course queue, handling navigation and grid view selection events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the home button; transfers control to 'AdminPanel.aspx'.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the profile button; currently empty.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the leaderboard button; transfers control to 'AdminLeaderboard.aspx'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the logout button click; transfers control to 'LoginPage.aspx'.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a row in GridView2 is selected; retrieves the course ID from the selected row, stores it in session, and transfers control to the same page.
